# NNN: Title

Decision status: Proposed | Accepted | Superseded by ADR NNN.

## Context

What situation required a decision. State the facts and the constraints; do not record
implementation progress.

## Decision

### D1. First decision

What is decided and why.

### D2. Second decision

What is decided and why.

## Consequences

What follows from the decision, including what is removed or no longer allowed.

## Non-goals

What this decision does not change.

## Supersession

Which ADR this supersedes, or which ADR supersedes it. Do not edit an accepted ADR to record
this; add the new ADR.
